dict.string: JARVIS needs Apple Events access to coordinate local desktop automation when the operator authorizes it.
JARVIS needs camera access only when the operator explicitly enables local video-aware cockpit or recording workflows.
JARVIS needs Desktop folder access when the operator asks it to inspect or manage local research files.
JARVIS needs Documents folder access when the operator asks it to inspect or manage local research files.
JARVIS needs Downloads folder access when the operator asks it to inspect or manage local research files.
JARVIS needs microphone access for hands-free voice commands and live cockpit listening.
JARVIS needs screen recording access when the operator enables visual cockpit or screen-aware workflows.
JARVIS needs speech recognition access to transcribe operator voice commands inside the cockpit.
